quality_guards: Near-real-time air-quality readings are not promoted to final evidence before ratification.
DAQI and forecast bands remain regional or monitoring-location context and are not converted into parcel exposure measurements.
UK-AIR service migration is handled through source discovery rather than hard-coded legacy URLs.
COMAH establishment information does not provide a parcel-specific accident probability or impact-distance model.
National drinking-water compliance does not guarantee the condition at an individual property tap.
Drinking-water event counts and Event Risk Index values remain company or national regulatory context.
Food-hygiene ratings describe conditions at the last local-authority inspection and are not live measurements.
Daily-changing food-business counts are stored with their extract timestamp.
Bulk FHRS refreshes must use nightly open-data files to avoid API-throttling failure paths.
Current source verification does not replace 130-candidate/16-endpoint live parity, browser DOM/console acceptance, commit ancestry, publisher push or remote readback.
No second runner was started; the stale single-runner recovery blocker remains OPEN.
